Structural masks/topology remain in their own cache identities. Certified charts force retry off while preserving requested envelope retention. Public and private mask plans own separate immutable caches.
source_checks.sidecars_and_failures: Successful primary/export and analytic/Hybrid/planar scatters couple actual returned primals and native precision to output-indexed operands. Disabled targets no-op without allocation; enabled targets reject missing source envelopes. Ordinary successful status is not replaced by a sidecar error; the six-point consumer rejects unsupported context. Quadrature routes remain unsupported.
source_checks.counters_and_flags: Fresh aggregate planar certificate work resets before batch and typed-Dual validation. Invoked child work is harvested before errors; cached previous-call counters are not summed. Opted-in nested analytic/Hybrid counters and analytic-attempt flags are retained; ordinary accounting is unchanged. Thin wrapper harvests child/parent execution and certificate totals before propagating results and collects all six child attempt flags.
source_checks.mathematical_scope: Seven central routines are byte-identical to the qualified private baseline: Symbolica weights, Cramer cofactor numerators, private parent construction, child mass dimensions, complete-slot assembly, final UV rule and full-shape mask certificates. No proof receipt transfer or receipt implementation is present.
source_checks.contraction_and_metadata: Public adapter uses the existing ContractionPlan on the private parent without exposing imported parameter count. Parent input layout remains31 complex parameters; all four Laurent slots and established basis/metadata survive packing and scatter.
